templates.name: AI product app shell
templates.description: Branded collapsible rail with grouped session history, breadcrumbs and new-chat in the bar, citations in a dialog, provenance panel on demand — the VSS/Ask starting point.

templates.name: Auth screens
templates.description: Sign in, SSO, two-factor, accept-invite and password reset — five screens on one split layout, with the error and locked-out states most auth flows leave until last.

templates.name: Dashboard / analytics
templates.description: KPI tiles, a sortable data table, a run log and an empty state — mono tabular numerics throughout.

templates.name: Data export & reports
templates.description: The pattern for work that takes longer than a click: queue it, show real progress, deliver it somewhere, and make a failure retryable without rebuilding the request.

templates.name: Docs / spec page
templates.description: Three-column documentation page — nav rail, prose with code blocks and callouts, on-this-page index.

templates.name: List → detail → edit
templates.description: The most common screen in any back-office: a filtered list, a detail view, an edit mode with an unsaved-changes guard, bulk actions and role-gated destructive controls.

templates.name: Marketing landing page
templates.description: One continuous ground, light or dark, carrying the honeycomb left and the mark right with ambient drift; left-aligned hero, three guarantees, grounded-answer proof, use cases, one CTA. Placeholder cop

templates.name: Onboarding wizard
templates.description: A multi-step form that validates per step, never loses work going back, resumes where you left off, and ends on a review screen that can still reach every field.

templates.name: Pitch deck
templates.description: 1920×1080 deck on the LeanWise palette — dark section openers, mono eyebrows, one amber CTA at the close.

templates.name: Search + filter + results
templates.description: Faceted search with applied-filter chips, three distinct result states (no query / no results / results), and the empty-vs-no-results distinction most products get wrong.

templates.name: Settings & forms
templates.description: Sectioned settings page — Field/Input/Select/Switch with help, error and destructive-action patterns.

templates.name: Transactional email
templates.description: A 600px table-based email that survives Outlook: literal values, padded-anchor buttons, one max-width breakpoint, and a plain-text version beside it.
